Interface ITty

Namespace
Tuinet
Assembly
Tuinet.dll

The platform seam: raw byte I/O with a terminal. Implement it to run a Tuinet.Terminal over anything (a pty, a socket, a test double).

public interface ITty : IDisposable

IDisposable

CanSuspend

Whether Tuinet.ITty.Suspend can stop the process (Unix job control). False by default.

bool CanSuspend { get; }

bool

Size

Current size. Must be cheap: called on every poll. Backends refresh it on resize notification.

Property Value

Methods

Read(Span<byte>, int)

Wait up to timeoutMs (-1 = forever, 0 = don't wait) for input and read it. Returns 0 on timeout, on Tuinet.ITty.Wake, or when the size may have changed.

int Read(Span<byte> buffer, int timeoutMs)

Parameters

buffer Span<byte>
timeoutMs int

Returns

int

Restore()

Restore the terminal's original modes (termios / console modes). Idempotent; must not throw.

void Restore()

Suspend()

Restore the original modes, stop the process until it is continued (e.g. the shell's fg), then re-enter raw mode. Called only when Tuinet.ITty.CanSuspend; Tuinet.Terminal writes the leave and enter sequences around it.

void Suspend()

TakeSignals()

Job-control signals from outside the app since the last call; called on every poll, so it must be cheap. Before reporting Tuinet.TtySignals.Continued, re-apply raw mode.

TtySignals TakeSignals()

Returns

TtySignals

Wake()

Make a blocked Tuinet.ITty.Read(System.Span{System.Byte},System.Int32) return now. Callable from any thread.

void Wake()
